The '''Systems Army Delta''' was one of the ten [[Systems Army/Legends|Systems Armies]] that composed the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Description==
The Systems Army Delta consisted of 294,912 [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] and was commanded by a [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]],<ref name="Insider 84" /> a role filled at this level by a member of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]]. This [[Systems Army/Legends|Systems Army]] was composed of two [[Sector Army/Legends|Sector Armies]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

The Systems Army Delta received its designation from the [[Tionese/Legends|Tionese letter]] ''[[Delta]]''.<ref name="Hyperspace">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/writtenword/index.html?page=1|text=The Written Word|int=The Written Word}}</ref>

==History==
[[File:NorthernQuadrant-EGW.jpg|thumb|right|290px|[[Systems Army/Legends|Systems Armies]] Delta, [[Systems Army Epsilon|Epsilon]] and [[Systems Army Zeta|Zeta]] divided the northern quadrant of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] into six [[Sector Army/Legends|Sector Armies]]]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Systems Armies Delta, [[Systems Army Epsilon|Epsilon]] and [[Systems Army Zeta|Zeta]] were assigned to the northern quadrant of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. These three Systems Armies were divided into six Sector Armies: the [[Seventh Army]], the [[Eighth Army]], the [[Ninth Army]], the [[Tenth Army]], the [[Eleventh Army]] and the [[Twelfth Army/Legends|Twelfth Army]].<ref name="TEGtW" />
